name: skillhub
description: Rahul Bera's personal Claude Code skills: research plotting, commits, research-log reports, and Slurm job orchestration.

plugins.name: ggplot-house-style
plugins.description: Generate publication-quality charts in a consistent house style (ggplot2 + hrbrthemes, dual PNG/PDF export, a numbers-CSV behind every chart). Orients to a project's data format once, persists it, then plots.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Prepare a clean, convention-following git commit in any repo. Detects the repo's commit conventions once, persists them to a .commit-profile, then formats, verifies, stages, and commits.

plugins.name: research-report
plugins.description: Write a research-log report for a completed experiment or mechanism study, organized like a scientific paper (Key Idea, Mechanism, Evaluation Methodology, Key Results, Next Steps).

plugins.name: slurm-launch
plugins.description: Launch, monitor, and collect batch jobs on a remote SSH-only Slurm cluster via a pluggable per-repo backend (configure/submit/status/collect).
